This PR creates a new function `genSecretsReplacement`. It's `genJqSecretsReplacement` for any config file format. It achieves that by taking a generator following the `pkgs.formats.*`. This new function can become the underlying function that all other secret generation function uses. Now, `genJqSecretsReplacement` is simply defined in terms of `genSecretsReplacement`.

This made it possible to integrate free form module with secrets in configuration. It doesn't require any specific wiring, just using the functions in the correct location. This is reflected in the manual.

The previous implementation of `genJqSecretsReplacement` could not be salvaged as it was very specific to JSON. Instead, it uses the python [replace-secrets](https://search.nixos.org/packages?channel=25.11&query=replace-secret&show=replace-secret) package which had to be updated to add a `--quote` and `--quote-char` option.

The [previous PR](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/495933) added regression tests which ensure this function does not break any use case.
